findings: U303 left shift 0.20 mm provides measured pad clearance for the straight ADC route and the reference-aware ground bridge; native courtyard and existing connections pass.
C1403 stays fixed; its local comparator sense path is unchanged. H filter relocation was rejected for a longer actual path despite passing Euclidean adjacency.
Ground bridge retains 0.30 mm width, with four deliberate segments and full In4 reference coverage. The three-segment K proposal was rejected for reference gaps.
Upper ADC retains outward routing outside nominal same-face bodies; two 0.10 mm offsets are removed.

The GND bridge overlaps opposite-face R702/C913 projections. Their F copper and placement are unchanged; In4 ground is continuous beneath the new traces. This is scoped geometric review, not coupling or thermal qualification.
